'''Skeleton Mages''' are monsters found in the [[Waterfall Dungeon]]. They primarily use [[Magic]] to attack. Thus, it is recommended to wear magic-resistant armour such as [[dragonhide armour]]. Level 19 skeleton mages cast earth spells and will sometimes cast the [[Weaken]] spell on a player. They also occasionally use a melee attack.

==Trivia==
* Skeleton mages can perform the [[Zombie Dance]] and [[Zombie Walk]] emotes, even though they are skeletons.
* If you try to open a pot of [[bone seeds]] too close to [[Malignius Mortifer]], he will say, "You should take that pot further away from me before you open it!"
